title: win goal >= 2^32 silently truncates via u32(v) (no range guard)
detail: parse_uint returns uint (64-bit on this target); u32(v) drops high bits with no check. `win goal 4294967296` -> goal 0 -> WIN disabled; `4294967297` -> goal 1. Wrong/disabled outcome, no error.
recommended_fix: Range-check before the cast: if v > uint(u32(max)) return the existing `bad win goal` parse error instead of truncating.

title: sub-tick lose cap floors to tick_cap 0, silently disabling lose
detail: A cap_ms < 1000/hz (e.g. 25ms @ 20Hz) integer-divides to 0; win_lose_eval treats tick_cap==0 as 'no cap', so a configured lose condition never fires. Silent, no warning — unlike a sub-tick spawn (tick 0 = immediate), tick_cap 0 = disabled.
recommended_fix: Floor to 1 tick when cap_ms > 0 (max(1, cfg.cap_ms*i64(hz)/1000)) so any set cap still loses, or reject sub-tick caps in parse_demo.
